abilities.name: Command
abilities.pve: 5% more {class} pet damage; not 5% more total character damage.
abilities.pvp: 5% more pet damage while your pet is attacking. No bonus without a pet.

recommendation.focus: Pet-using Hunters and Warlocks, especially builds where an active pet contributes a large share of damage.
recommendation.advice: Useful while your pet deals damage. The more of your damage comes from the pet, the more this matters; a sacrificed, dismissed or inactive pet gains nothing.

impact.summary: Moderate impact · scales with active pet damage

Warlock.summary: Situational impact · requires an active damage-dealing pet

abilities.name: Blood Fury
abilities.pve: Time an offensive burst window with your other damage cooldowns.
abilities.pvp: Extra offensive pressure during a coordinated burst.

recommendation.focus: DPS Warriors, Rogues and Hunters; damage-focused Shaman, Mages and Warlocks. Tanks can use it for offensive threat.
recommendation.advice: Use during attack- or spell-damage windows. Tank value is offensive threat, not damage reduction.

byRole.healer: Primarily an offensive option when you can safely deal damage; do not count this damage-oriented description as a verified healing cooldown.

impact.summary: Moderate impact · offensive burst

healer.summary: Low healing priority · offensive use only

Druid.pve: Spell-power burst for Druid damage windows.

Paladin.pve: Spell-power burst for Paladin damage windows.

Priest.pve: Spell-power burst for Priest damage windows.

Rogue.pve: Attack-power burst for Rogue damage windows.

Shaman.pve: Supports attack and spell damage during offensive windows.

Warlock.pve: Spell-power burst for Warlock damage windows.

Warrior.pve: Attack-power burst for Warrior damage windows.

abilities.name: Hardiness
abilities.pve: Helps against encounter stuns that affect your character.
abilities.pvp: Shortens stun-based crowd control so you can resume acting sooner.

recommendation.focus: All Orc classes in stun-heavy PvP; tanks, healers and DPS in encounters with relevant stuns.
recommendation.advice: Shorter stuns help you resume attacks, movement or healing. Its value depends on opponents or encounters actually stunning you, not on your damage specialization.

impact.summary: High PvP utility against stuns · encounter-dependent in PvE

abilities.name: Shatter Curse
abilities.effect: Dispels curses/banes; 5% less magic damage taken for 8 sec.
abilities.pve: A defensive option when enemies apply curses or magic damage.
abilities.pvp: Removes curse/banes pressure and helps cover incoming magic burst.

recommendation.focus: All Orc classes facing curses or magic damage; especially targeted healers and tanks during relevant damage windows.
recommendation.advice: Use against removable curses or relevant magic damage. Tanks can cover a magic-damage window; healers and DPS can reduce pressure on themselves. Encounter-specific rather than a constant throughput bonus.

impact.summary: High defensive value when curses or magic pressure matter

abilities.name: Ruthless
abilities.pve: More eligible critical strikes for damage and healing.
abilities.pvp: Adds critical-strike potential to offensive or healing windows.

recommendation.focus: Human DPS classes and critical-heal builds, including Holy Paladins and healing Priests using eligible crit interactions.
recommendation.advice: Useful for damage that can critically strike. It does not make every periodic or utility effect able to crit.

byRole.healer: Supports heals that can critically strike; value depends on your healing toolkit and crit interactions. Do not count non-critting shields or every heal-over-time tick as a benefit.

impact.summary: Moderate impact · eligible damage crits

tank.summary: Moderate impact · offensive threat, not mitigation

Druid.pvp: Can support burst damage or eligible critical heals.

Mage.pvp: More critical-strike potential during offensive windows.

abilities.name: The Human Spirit
abilities.pve: Recovery between pulls; value depends on your resource mechanics.
abilities.pvp: Recovery during downtime rather than an immediate resource refill.

recommendation.focus: Healer classes: Holy/Discipline Priests and Holy Paladins. Also useful for Mages using Spirit-based regeneration tools.
recommendation.advice: Minor baseline value for mana-using DPS; more useful when mana limits your uptime and your build activates Spirit-based regeneration. It does not directly increase damage.

byRole.healer: High potential value for sustained healing when Spirit regeneration is active. Talents and pauses in mana spending determine how much extra mana you actually gain; this is not a fixed healing increase.

byClass.Warrior: Minimal gameplay impact for melee DPS or tanking: only minor downtime health recovery. No rage, direct damage or mitigation benefit.
byClass.Rogue: Minimal gameplay impact for melee DPS: only minor downtime health recovery. No energy regeneration or direct damage benefit.
byClass.Mage: Minor baseline DPS impact, with potentially greater sustain when mana is limiting. Mage Armor, Evocation or Spirit-regeneration talents can make it more useful; casting pattern matters.

impact.summary: Minor baseline impact · conditional mana sustain

healer.summary: High potential impact · healer mana sustain

Mage.summary: Minor baseline impact · can grow with regeneration tools

adviceByClassRole.Priest:healer: High potential impact for healer mana sustain, especially with Meditation if talented. Holy Spirit-scaling talents can add value; your casting pattern and chosen talents still matter.
adviceByClassRole.Priest:caster: Minor baseline damage impact; Spirit can improve mana sustain through relevant talents. Do not assume every Shadow build gets the same benefit.
adviceByClassRole.Paladin:healer: High potential impact for healing sustain when talents allow Spirit regeneration during casting. Otherwise, recovery breaks matter; it is not a guaranteed increase to every heal.
adviceByClassRole.Paladin:tank: Minor baseline impact for tanking: conditional mana sustain rather than direct threat or damage reduction. More useful if mana is limiting your tanking actions.
adviceByClassRole.Paladin:melee: Minor baseline impact for mana-using melee DPS. It may reduce mana downtime, but does not directly increase attack damage.

Rogue.pve: For Rogue, Spirit is recovery utility; there is no mana benefit.

Warrior.pve: For Warrior, Spirit is recovery utility; there is no mana benefit.

abilities.name: Will to Survive
abilities.pve: Can release you from encounter stuns.
abilities.pvp: Breaks a stun so you can reposition or respond.

recommendation.focus: All Human classes in stun-heavy PvP; healers protecting cast access, melee maintaining uptime, and targets needing an escape.
recommendation.advice: A stun escape can restore control so you can heal, defend or attack. Plan around applicable cooldown restrictions; there is little value in a fight without stuns.

impact.summary: High PvP utility against stuns · encounter-dependent in PvE

abilities.name: Perception
abilities.pve: Useful where enemies use stealth.
abilities.pvp: Helps detect stealthed opponents; positioning still matters.

recommendation.focus: Human PvP players defending objectives or countering Rogues/Druids; any class supporting an anti-stealth team plan.
recommendation.advice: Useful for spotting stealth approaches before an opener. Protecting a healer or objective can matter as much as finding a target for DPS; this is not a general raid damage bonus.

impact.summary: High anti-stealth utility · minimal general PvE impact

abilities.name: Artisan’s Precision
abilities.pve: Helps offensive attacks/spells reach hit requirements.
abilities.pvp: Improves eligible offensive hit reliability.

recommendation.focus: Dwarf DPS classes and tank Warriors/Protection Paladins below relevant offensive hit requirements; not a priority for friendly healing.
recommendation.advice: Useful for landing attacks or offensive spells while below the relevant hit requirement. Tank value is landing threat abilities; it is not extra mitigation.

byRole.healer: Heals on allies do not need offensive hit chance. Useful mainly when you attack or use hostile utility that can miss; do not treat this as a healing-throughput racial.

impact.summary: Moderate impact below the relevant offensive hit requirement

healer.summary: Low healing priority · minimal impact on friendly heals

tank.summary: Moderate impact · landing offensive threat abilities

abilities.name: Stoneform
abilities.effect: 8 sec: bleed/poison/disease immunity and reduced physical damage.
abilities.pve: A defensive tool for matching debuffs and physical pressure.
abilities.pvp: Counters matching debuffs and helps survive physical burst.

recommendation.focus: Dwarf tank Warriors and Protection Paladins; any Dwarf healer or DPS facing physical damage, bleeds, poisons or diseases.
recommendation.advice: A defensive choice against physical damage or eligible bleeds, poisons and diseases. Healers and DPS also benefit when targeted; encounter pressure matters more than a fixed class ranking.

byRole.tank: Useful for a planned physical-damage or eligible debuff window. It supplements your tank cooldowns rather than covering every kind of incoming damage.

impact.summary: High defensive value against relevant physical damage or debuffs

tank.summary: High potential tanking impact · physical/debuff windows

abilities.name: Big Game Hunter
abilities.pve: A damage benefit only when the target is a Beast.
abilities.pvp: Useful against enemy targets classified as Beasts.

recommendation.focus: Dwarf damage dealers and tanks fighting Beasts; not a direct bonus to healer output.
recommendation.advice: Useful only while damaging Beast-type enemies. Tanks may gain offensive threat; healing allies receives no direct benefit.

byRole.healer: Relevant when you contribute damage against Beasts. It does not improve your healing, and has no damage benefit against other creature types.

impact.summary: Moderate damage impact against Beasts · none against other types

healer.summary: Low healing priority · Beast damage only

abilities.name: Find Treasure
abilities.effect: Treasure tracking; chance for extra chest items.
abilities.pve: Helps with exploration and chest farming.
abilities.pvp: Chest-farming utility for preparation.

recommendation.focus: All Dwarf classes interested in treasure routes and farming; no combat-role preference.
recommendation.advice: Choose for treasure routes and looting convenience. It has no direct healing, tanking or DPS effect; class role does not establish a combat preference.

impact.summary: Exploration / farming utility · minimal direct combat impact

abilities.name: Elune’s Light
abilities.pve: Plan around a temporary critical-strike window.
abilities.pvp: Can support burst pressure or healing where critical strikes apply.

recommendation.focus: Night Elf DPS and healing Priests/Restoration Druids using eligible critical heals; tanks may use the offensive burst.
recommendation.advice: Time with damage that can critically strike. Effects that cannot crit do not gain the full benefit.

byRole.healer: A burst-healing option for heals that can crit. Discipline can pair eligible critical heals with Divine Aegis if talented; non-critting shields do not gain critical chance.

impact.summary: Moderate impact · eligible burst damage

healer.summary: Moderate impact · eligible burst critical heals

abilities.name: Shadowmeld
abilities.pve: Situational concealment while stationary.
abilities.pvp: Can support concealment and positioning while stationary.

recommendation.focus: All Night Elf classes using stationary concealment; situational positioning rather than a class throughput recommendation.
recommendation.advice: Useful for stationary concealment and setting up an approach. Do not assume a boss-threat reset, moving stealth or immunity from this description.

byClass.Rogue: Useful for stationary concealment, but your class already has stealth tools. Choose based on positioning needs rather than assuming extra damage.
byClass.Druid: Useful for stationary concealment, alongside your form-based toolkit. It is not moving stealth or a guaranteed tank threat reset.

impact.summary: Situational stealth utility · minimal direct throughput impact

abilities.name: Quickness
abilities.pve: Mobility and dodge against attacks that can be dodged.
abilities.pvp: Movement for positioning and dodge against eligible attacks.

recommendation.focus: Night Elf tank Warriors and Bear Druids for eligible physical avoidance; all roles for movement and positioning.
recommendation.advice: Movement helps every role reposition. Dodge matters when eligible physical attacks reach you; it is not protection against all damage.

byRole.tank: A useful physical-avoidance and positioning option. Dodge is chance-based, not a guaranteed defensive cooldown.
byRole.hybrid: Bear tanking can use the physical avoidance; Cat DPS can use positioning. The saved Feral label alone does not tell which role you play.
byRole.healer: Positioning and survival when attacked, rather than direct healing throughput. Avoid deliberately taking melee hits to gain value.

impact.summary: Moderate positioning value · conditional physical avoidance

tank.summary: Moderate tank utility · physical avoidance and movement

hybrid.summary: Moderate utility · Bear avoidance / Cat positioning

healer.summary: Situational survival / movement · no direct healing increase

Druid.pvp: Movement for positioning and dodge against eligible attacks. Also improves your stealth concealment by one effective level.

Rogue.pvp: Movement for positioning and dodge against eligible attacks. Also improves your stealth concealment by one effective level.

abilities.name: Wisp Spirit
abilities.pve: Faster corpse travel after a death.
abilities.pvp: Faster corpse runs after a death.

recommendation.focus: All Night Elf classes for travel after death; no healer, tank or DPS advantage while alive.
recommendation.advice: Helps travel while dead. It does not improve performance while alive; class and combat role provide no special synergy.

impact.summary: Death-recovery utility · no gameplay impact while alive

abilities.name: Escape Artist
abilities.pve: Useful against movement restrictions.
abilities.pvp: Helps maintain movement against roots and snares.

recommendation.focus: Gnome melee DPS maintaining target access and Gnome casters/healing Priests escaping roots or snares in PvP.
recommendation.advice: Useful against roots and snares to reach targets or escape pressure. It does not remove every form of crowd control.

byRole.healer: A mobility tool for escaping roots or snares and reaching healing range. It is survival and positioning utility, not extra healing per cast.
byRole.tank: Useful when roots or snares prevent positioning or picking up enemies. Boss immunity and encounter mechanics still apply.

impact.summary: High PvP mobility value against roots and snares

abilities.name: Eureka!
abilities.effect: 8 sec: resource costs reduced by 10%; eligible damage increased by 10%.
abilities.pve: A short efficiency and throughput window for eligible abilities.
abilities.pvp: Can support burst and resource efficiency; periodic effects are excluded.

recommendation.focus: Gnome Mages, Warlocks, Rogues and Warriors for eligible damage/resource windows; healing Priests for documented healing efficiency.
recommendation.advice: Time with eligible damage and resource spending. Reduced costs are useful only while you are actually spending resources.

byClass.Priest: A healing/damage efficiency window; the documented Priest interaction includes Power Word: Shield. Time it around planned casts rather than assuming every effect is increased.

impact.summary: Moderate impact · short burst / resource-efficiency window

Priest.summary: High potential impact · healing / damage efficiency window

abilities.name: Expansive Mind
abilities.pve: More resource capacity to manage encounters.
abilities.pvp: More resource capacity for your chosen class.

recommendation.focus: Gnome healing Priests and mana-using casters; Rogues/Warriors when extra energy/rage capacity is useful.
recommendation.advice: A larger resource pool offers more room for spending or pooling. It does not itself increase regeneration or guarantee more damage.

byRole.healer: Additional mana capacity can support a healing sequence. It is not mana regeneration and does not remove the need to manage spell costs.

impact.summary: Moderate resource flexibility · no regeneration increase

healer.summary: Moderate healing sustain value · extra mana capacity

abilities.name: Engineering Specialization
abilities.pve: Useful when you use Engineering devices.
abilities.pvp: Helps when Engineering devices are part of your preparation.

recommendation.focus: Any Gnome class actively using Engineering devices; no extra role recommendation without relevant devices.
recommendation.advice: Useful when your plan actually uses Engineering devices. Without relevant devices there is no direct role benefit; exact value depends on the item and its failure behaviour.

impact.summary: Useful with Engineering devices · minimal impact without them

abilities.name: Will of the Forsaken
abilities.effect: Removes charm, fear and sleep; unavailable during Scatter Shot.
abilities.pve: A response to matching encounter crowd control.
abilities.pvp: Counters charm/fear/sleep, not stuns; cannot be used during Scatter Shot.

recommendation.focus: All Undead classes in fear/charm/sleep-heavy PvP; healers, tanks or DPS in encounters with those effects.
recommendation.advice: Useful when the listed control effects would stop you healing, defending or attacking. Its restrictions still apply; do not treat it as an answer to every crowd-control effect.

impact.summary: High PvP utility against fear / charm / sleep

abilities.name: Cannibalize
abilities.pve: Between-pull sustain when a suitable corpse is available.
abilities.pvp: Situational recovery when you can safely use a corpse.

recommendation.focus: Solo Undead DPS and mana-using classes recovering between fights; healers when a safe corpse-based recovery window exists.
recommendation.advice: Useful for recovery with an eligible corpse and a safe opportunity. Movement, actions or incoming damage can interrupt it; it is unreliable during active pressure.

byRole.healer: Can restore resources between fights without spending a heal. Use only when a safe corpse-based recovery window will not delay needed group healing.

byClass.Warrior: Useful for health recovery between pulls with an eligible corpse. The mana component does nothing for rage.
byClass.Rogue: Useful for health recovery between pulls with an eligible corpse. The mana component does nothing for energy.

impact.summary: Moderate solo / between-pull recovery · safe corpse required

healer.summary: Moderate downtime recovery · low value during active healing

Rogue.pve: Between-pull sustain when a suitable corpse is available. For Rogue, the mana component is not useful.

Warrior.pve: Between-pull sustain when a suitable corpse is available. For Warrior, the mana component is not useful.

abilities.name: Touch of the Grave
abilities.effect: Occasional health drain; 25 sec internal cooldown.
abilities.pve: A small damage/sustain proc; no fixed DPS gain is assumed.
abilities.pvp: Occasional extra pressure and sustain; not an on-demand heal.

recommendation.focus: Undead damage dealers and offensive tanks for supplemental damage/recovery; healers only when using eligible offensive triggers.
recommendation.advice: A damage-and-recovery supplement while you trigger it with eligible attacks or spells. It is not a dependable emergency heal.

byRole.healer: A supplemental benefit when you contribute eligible damage. Do not assume casting only friendly heals will trigger it or rely on it for an emergency save.

impact.summary: Minor supplemental damage / self-recovery

healer.summary: Low healing priority · requires eligible offensive triggers

abilities.name: Underwater Breathing
abilities.pve: Useful on underwater routes.
abilities.pvp: Longer underwater routes and breathing time.

recommendation.focus: All Undead classes doing underwater quests, routes or objectives; no general combat-role preference.
recommendation.advice: Useful on underwater routes or objectives. It does not add damage, healing or mitigation; class-role preference is minimal.

impact.summary: Underwater-route utility · minimal general combat impact

abilities.name: War Stomp
abilities.pve: Can help control enemies that are susceptible to stuns.
abilities.pvp: A short crowd-control opportunity; enemy immunity still matters.

recommendation.focus: Tauren tank Warriors/Bear Druids controlling eligible adds; Shaman/Druid healers peeling nearby enemies; any role needing close control.
recommendation.advice: Useful to create space, interrupt an eligible enemy or assist a teammate nearby. Stun-immune enemies gain no such control effect.

byRole.tank: Can help control nearby stunnable adds. It is not a boss stun or a substitute for tank mitigation.
byRole.hybrid: Useful for nearby stunnable enemies whether tanking or dealing damage; check form and ability-use restrictions in game.
byRole.healer: Can create a brief opening to move or cast when enemies are close. Do not enter dangerous melee range solely to use it.

impact.summary: High close-range control value against stunnable enemies

abilities.name: Endurance
abilities.effect: +5% health; no extra hit or critical-damage modifier.
abilities.pve: A larger health buffer for incoming damage.
abilities.pvp: A larger health buffer against player pressure.

recommendation.focus: Tauren tank Warriors and Bear Druids; any Tauren class needing a larger health buffer against dangerous damage.
recommendation.advice: A larger health buffer helps survive incoming damage. It does not reduce damage taken or directly improve healing or DPS.

byRole.tank: A useful health buffer for tanking, especially when surviving a damage spike matters. It is extra health, not extra hit chance or damage reduction.
byRole.hybrid: Useful as a health buffer when Bear tanking, and for survival as Cat DPS. Your current form and assignment determine the practical value.

impact.summary: Moderate survival value · extra health buffer

tank.summary: High potential tanking value · larger health buffer

hybrid.summary: Moderate survival value · more relevant while tanking

abilities.name: Plainsrunning
abilities.effect: +2% movement per stack, up to +60%; no mounted bonus.
abilities.pve: Travel/repositioning while maintaining the movement-based effect.
abilities.pvp: Movement for positioning while the movement-based effect is maintained.

recommendation.focus: All Tauren classes for sustained travel and movement; less relevant to stationary tanking or healing assignments.
recommendation.advice: Useful on routes where you can keep moving. Stops and damage reduce its benefit; do not assume full stacks during a stationary tanking or casting assignment.

byRole.healer: Useful for travel and repositioning, but standing still to cast works against sustained movement. This is not a direct healing bonus.

impact.summary: Travel / movement utility · limited during stationary combat

abilities.name: Cultivation
abilities.pve: Material-gathering utility for preparation.
abilities.pvp: Herb-gathering utility for consumable preparation.

recommendation.focus: All Tauren classes interested in herbs and gathering; no direct healer, tank or DPS preference.
recommendation.advice: Useful for bonus herbs and resource gathering. It has no direct combat-role synergy and does not make you a stronger healer or tank by itself.

impact.summary: Gathering / economy utility · minimal direct combat impact

abilities.name: Berserking
abilities.pve: A speed window for eligible attacks and spellcasts.
abilities.pvp: Faster eligible casts or attacks during pressure or recovery.

recommendation.focus: Troll DPS using eligible attacks/casts; healing Priests and Restoration Shaman needing faster eligible casts with sufficient mana.
recommendation.advice: Useful for eligible attacks or spell casts during a planned window. Faster actions can increase resource spending; haste is not automatically more damage or healing over an entire fight.

byRole.healer: Useful when faster eligible healing casts are valuable and mana allows. Do not assume that every periodic effect gains extra ticks.

impact.summary: Moderate impact · eligible attack / casting-speed window

healer.summary: Moderate healing impact · cast speed with sufficient mana

abilities.name: Rapid Regeneration
abilities.pve: A recovery tool, not an instant half-health heal.
abilities.pvp: Sustain over time when you can benefit from the recovery.

recommendation.focus: Solo Troll DPS, especially non-healing classes such as Warriors and Rogues; any injured role with a safe self-recovery window.
recommendation.advice: Useful for recovering your own health when you can benefit from the full recovery period. It is not an instant emergency heal.

byRole.healer: Can save mana otherwise spent healing yourself, but does not heal your party. Use when safe without delaying urgent group healing.
byRole.tank: An additional self-recovery option in a safe window, not instant protection against a lethal spike. Confirm its use restrictions in game before planning it into active tanking.

impact.summary: Moderate solo sustain · self-recovery window required

healer.summary: Lower healing priority · personal recovery, not group healing

tank.summary: Situational tank recovery · not instant spike protection

abilities.name: Beast Slaying
abilities.pve: Useful against Beast enemies only.
abilities.pvp: Useful against enemy targets classified as Beasts.

recommendation.focus: Troll damage dealers and tank Warriors fighting Beasts; not a direct bonus to healer output.
recommendation.advice: Useful only while damaging Beast-type enemies. Tanks may gain offensive threat; healing allies receives no direct benefit.

byRole.healer: Relevant when you contribute damage against Beasts. It does not improve your healing, and has no damage benefit against other creature types.

impact.summary: Moderate damage impact against Beasts · none against other types

healer.summary: Low healing priority · Beast damage only

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.pve: Adds sustain through health regeneration.
abilities.pvp: Passive sustain rather than a burst heal.

recommendation.focus: Solo Troll classes reducing health downtime and tank Warriors seeking supplemental sustain; lower priority for healer throughput.
recommendation.advice: Useful when health regeneration can reduce downtime or sustained pressure. The bonus scales regeneration, not your maximum health; it is not a large emergency heal.

byRole.tank: A small source of sustained recovery while taking damage. Its value depends on your baseline regeneration and missing health; do not replace mitigation or healer support with it.
byRole.healer: May reduce the healing you need on yourself while injured. It does not regenerate mana or strengthen heals on allies, so it is a secondary sustain benefit rather than a healing-throughput choice.

impact.summary: Minor baseline impact · supplemental solo sustain

tank.summary: Minor tanking impact · supplemental recovery only

healer.summary: Low healing priority · minor personal sustain

abilities.name: Wind Blessed
abilities.pve: Faster eligible melee/ranged attacks and spellcasts.
abilities.pvp: Can help pressure and eligible cast throughput.

recommendation.focus: Skyborne damage dealers and Restoration Druids/Shaman using eligible attacks or cast-time heals; tanks for offensive activity.
recommendation.advice: Useful for eligible melee, ranged or spellcasting actions. The gain depends on your rotation; do not assume all cooldowns or periodic ticks become faster.

byRole.healer: Can help deliver eligible casts sooner. It does not make each heal larger or automatically improve mana efficiency.

impact.summary: Moderate impact · eligible attacks and spell casts

healer.summary: Moderate healing impact · faster eligible casts

abilities.name: Elemental Insight
abilities.pve: A target-specific bonus when fighting Elementals.
abilities.pvp: Only applies when the enemy target is an Elemental.

recommendation.focus: Skyborne damage dealers and tanks fighting Elementals; not a direct bonus to healer output.
recommendation.advice: Useful only when damaging Elemental-type enemies. Tank value is offensive threat; healing allies gains no direct bonus.

byRole.healer: Relevant when contributing damage against Elementals. It does not strengthen heals, and does not improve damage against other creature types.

impact.summary: Moderate damage impact against Elementals · none otherwise

healer.summary: Low healing priority · Elemental damage only

abilities.name: Walk on Air
abilities.pve: Terrain and travel utility for reaching positions.
abilities.pvp: Situational downward travel and terrain positioning.

recommendation.focus: All Skyborne classes navigating descents and terrain; no general combat-role preference.
recommendation.advice: Useful when descending or navigating terrain. Check its movement restrictions in game; this is not a general tanking, healing or DPS cooldown.

impact.summary: Terrain / travel utility · minimal direct combat impact

abilities.name: Read Leyline
abilities.effect: 15 sec: +50% health/mana regeneration. Attuned raises this to +100%.
abilities.pve: Recovery utility; Attuned lasts 1 hour and survives death.
abilities.pvp: Situational recovery. Innervate takes priority and blocks use while active.

recommendation.focus: Alliance Skyborne Restoration Druids and mana-using DPS with active regeneration windows; less useful to Warriors/Rogues.
recommendation.advice: Useful when health or mana regeneration can actually occur. It boosts regeneration rather than instantly restoring a fixed portion of your resource pool.

byRole.healer: A recovery option when Spirit-based regeneration is active through a safe casting break or relevant talents. It cannot stack with Innervate; Attuned changes its strength.

byClass.Warrior: Health recovery only: you have no mana pool. It does not regenerate rage or directly improve threat or mitigation.
byClass.Rogue: Health recovery only: you have no mana pool. It does not regenerate energy or directly increase DPS.

impact.summary: Moderate recovery potential when regeneration is active

healer.summary: High potential mana-sustain value in a valid recovery window

Warrior.summary: Low combat priority · health recovery only

Rogue.summary: Low combat priority · health recovery only

abilities.pvp: A short movement window for positioning.

recommendation.focus: Horde Skyborne healers repositioning, melee pursuing targets, and any class whose PvP or encounter assignment needs movement.
recommendation.advice: Useful for chasing, escaping or reaching an objective. Healers can reach allies; tanks can reposition. Value depends on movement needs, not on a direct damage or healing increase.

abilities.name: Divine Grace
abilities.effect: Instant ally heal below 50% health; clears Weakened Soul. Cannot target yourself.
abilities.pve: Emergency ally recovery and an opportunity to shield that ally again.
abilities.pvp: Can rescue a low-health ally and reopen their shield option.

recommendation.focus: Human healing Priests rescuing eligible allies; Shadow Priests providing situational off-healing support.
recommendation.advice: Useful to save an eligible injured ally and support another shield by clearing Weakened Soul. It cannot save you directly because you cannot target yourself.

byRole.caster: An ally-support tool even while assigned DPS. Check form and casting restrictions; do not count the time spent supporting as free DPS.

impact.summary: High potential ally-rescue value · eligible injured target required

caster.summary: Situational off-healing value · costs time from DPS

abilities.name: Feedback
abilities.effect: 15 sec: hostile spells against you can burn the caster’s mana and deal damage.
abilities.pve: Situational value against enemies that cast spells at you.
abilities.pvp: Mana pressure when hostile casters successfully target you.

recommendation.focus: Human Priests of any specialization targeted by hostile casters, especially in relevant PvP matchups.
recommendation.advice: Most useful when hostile casters target you and the mana-burn effect applies. Healing and Shadow roles can both use defensive pressure; little benefit when enemies do not cast at you.

impact.summary: High anti-caster potential when enemies cast at you

abilities.name: Desperate Prayer
abilities.pve: An emergency self-heal; Shadow Priests must leave Shadowform first.
abilities.pvp: A self-survival option under pressure.

recommendation.focus: Dwarf healing Priests needing an emergency self-heal; Shadow Priests only when Shadowform does not prevent use.
recommendation.advice: A self-heal for sudden damage, freeing time or mana for other actions. It does not directly heal a teammate.

byRole.caster: An emergency self-heal, but unavailable in Shadowform. Account for that restriction before relying on it during a Shadow damage rotation.

impact.summary: High potential emergency self-survival value

abilities.name: Chastise
abilities.effect: Holy damage and 2 sec immobilize against Humanoids.
abilities.pve: Short control when an eligible Humanoid needs to be stopped.
abilities.pvp: A brief immobilize to help create distance or follow-up control.

recommendation.focus: Dwarf Priests of any specialization controlling eligible Humanoids, especially for PvP spacing or team support.
recommendation.advice: Useful to hold an eligible Humanoid briefly for spacing or coordinated pressure. It is an immobilize rather than a stun; creature and control immunities matter.

impact.summary: High control potential against eligible Humanoids

abilities.name: Starshards
abilities.effect: 6 sec Arcane damage channel; 30 sec cooldown.
abilities.pve: An additional damage option when you can safely channel.
abilities.pvp: Situational damage if you can maintain the channel.

recommendation.focus: Night Elf Priests contributing optional damage or playing solo; healing Priests only when required healing is covered.
recommendation.advice: A damage option when you can commit to the channel. Healing roles should prioritize required heals, and DPS roles should compare the opportunity cost with their normal rotation.

impact.summary: Low healing priority · optional damage / solo utility

caster.summary: Situational DPS value · compare channel opportunity cost

abilities.name: Elune’s Grace
abilities.effect: Melee/ranged attacks have 50% less chance to hit you for 15 sec or until 3 misses.
abilities.pve: A defensive window against eligible physical attacks.
abilities.pvp: Helps against melee/ranged pressure; spell hits use different mechanics.

recommendation.focus: Night Elf Priests of any specialization focused by melee or ranged attackers; defensive survival rather than extra healing.
recommendation.advice: Useful when melee or ranged attackers focus you. It supports survival rather than healing throughput; do not treat it as protection from all spells.

impact.summary: High survival potential under melee / ranged pressure

abilities.name: Confounding Flash
abilities.effect: 0.5 sec cast: confuse up to 5 enemies for 3 sec; damage breaks it.
abilities.pve: Short control when enemies need to be paused.
abilities.pvp: A brief control opportunity for escape or follow-up actions.

recommendation.focus: Gnome Priests of any specialization needing a brief peel or escape against confusable targets.
recommendation.advice: Useful for a short escape or peel when nearby enemies can be confused. Damage breaks the effect, so coordinate it with your group’s damage.

impact.summary: High control potential · confusion breaks on damage

abilities.name: Contingency Plan
abilities.effect: 30 sec ally ward: damage dropping them below 35% health triggers an absorb and healing over time.
abilities.pve: Pre-emptive protection before dangerous damage; amount depends on spell rank.
abilities.pvp: An advance safety net for an ally who may be focused.

recommendation.focus: Gnome healing Priests planning ally protection; damage-focused Priests supporting an ally before predictable danger.
recommendation.advice: Useful before predictable danger to an ally, for healing or DPS assignments. It is a conditional ward, so plan its trigger rather than treating it as an immediate heal.

impact.summary: High potential ally-protection value · trigger-dependent

abilities.name: Hex of Weakness
abilities.effect: Lowers melee attack power; healing received is reduced by 20% for 2 min.
abilities.pve: A debuff for eligible melee enemies or enemies receiving healing.
abilities.pvp: Healing reduction and weaker melee pressure on the affected target.

recommendation.focus: Troll Priests of any specialization providing PvP healing reduction or a relevant melee attack-power debuff.
recommendation.advice: Useful against targets receiving healing or dealing relevant melee damage. Healing and Shadow Priests can support their team with it; it is not a bonus to your own healing.

impact.summary: High PvP anti-healing value · target-dependent in PvE

abilities.name: Shadowguard
abilities.effect: 3 charges of retaliatory Shadow damage when attacked.
abilities.pve: Additional damage when enemies attack you.
abilities.pvp: Retaliatory pressure while opponents attack you.

recommendation.focus: Solo or PvP Troll Priests retaliating when attacked; lower priority for PvE healers who can avoid enemy attention.
recommendation.advice: Useful when eligible attacks reach you. Do not deliberately take avoidable damage for retaliation; PvE healers should normally avoid being attacked.

impact.summary: Minor retaliatory damage · only while attacked

healer.summary: Low healing priority · avoid taking hits for retaliation

abilities.name: Touch of Weakness
abilities.effect: The next melee hit against you triggers Shadow damage and a melee attack-power debuff.
abilities.pve: Extra damage and mitigation when an enemy reaches you in melee.
abilities.pvp: A response to melee attackers reaching you.

recommendation.focus: Undead Priests of any specialization pressured by melee enemies; defensive retaliation rather than healer throughput.
recommendation.advice: Useful when an enemy reaches you in melee. It offers retaliation and a debuff, not a reason to stand in melee or a direct healing increase.

impact.summary: Situational melee defence · minimal value without melee attackers

abilities.name: Dark Sacrifice
abilities.effect: Converts your health to mana over 15 sec; mana gained scales with Spirit.
abilities.pve: Trades health for mana when you can cover the health cost.
abilities.pvp: Situational mana recovery when your health is safe to spend.

recommendation.focus: Undead healing Priests and mana-constrained Shadow Priests when health can be safely traded for mana.
recommendation.advice: Useful when additional mana is worth the health cost. Spirit scaling can matter, but safety and recovery support determine whether to use it.

byRole.healer: A mana-sustain option when your health is safe to spend and you can cover the cost. Avoid using it into dangerous incoming damage.
byRole.caster: A mana-sustain option when you can safely trade health. It is not free mana, and the Spirit scaling does not justify risking death.

impact.summary: High mana-recovery potential when health is safe to spend
